raw_text: URGENT: Kakhovka dam has been destroyed. Massive water flow reported downstream. Residents of Nova Kakhovka report hearing explosion at approximately 0230 local time. Water level rising rapidly in low-lying areas. Evacuation orders being issued for downstream settlements on both banks of Dnipro.
clean_text: Kakhovka dam destroyed. Explosion heard at 0230 local time. Water level rising rapidly. Evacuation orders issued for downstream settlements on both Dnipro banks.
